title: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Chili (High-Protein, Veggie)
originalTitle: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Chili (High-Protein, Veggie)
ingredients: 💪 Protein: ~20–25g per serving (with toppings or added lentils)
1 medium sweet potato, peeled and diced (small cubes cook faster)
1 can (14 oz) kidney beans or pinto beans, rinsed
1/2 cup red lentils (optional for extra protein, cook right in the pot)
instructions: Sauté aromatics: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Add onion and garlic, cook 2–3 min until fragrant.
Add sweet potato & spices: Toss in sweet potato, bell pepper, and all spices. Stir 1–2 min.
Add beans, tomatoes & broth: Add diced tomatoes (with juice), tomato paste, beans, and broth.
(Optional) Add lentils: Stir in red lentils for extra protein.
Simmer: Bring to a boil, then reduce to simmer. Cover and cook 25–30 min, until sweet potatoes are tender and lentils (if using) are cooked.
Adjust seasoning: Taste and add more salt/spices as needed.
Serve hot with toppings of your choice.
